title: Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry Insured Return Surcharge
content:
The insured return surcharge of the Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry covers carrier insurance on valuable gifts sent back through Marlowe & Finch. It is set by the amount of the returned gift's guest gift entry and the return method on the registrant's return record, and it is deducted from the registry credit for the gift, the credit never going below zero.

| Guest gift entry amount | Return method | Surcharge |
|---|---|---|
| at least USD 750.00 (the upper insured amount) | prepaid label or carrier pickup | USD 15.00 (the upper insured surcharge) |
| at least USD 300.00 (the lower insured amount) but below USD 750.00 | prepaid label or carrier pickup | USD 5.00 (the lower insured surcharge) |
| below USD 300.00 | any | none |
| any | any other method | none |

**Boundary cases (hypothetical gifts)**

- USD 750.00 by carrier pickup → USD 15.00; USD 749.99 by carrier pickup → USD 5.00.
- USD 300.00 with a prepaid label → USD 5.00; USD 299.99 with a prepaid label → none.
- USD 1200.00 returned by any other method → none.

**Basis Q&A**

**Does the reason for the return change the surcharge?** No; only the gift entry amount and the return method decide it.
